clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers on Lakeridge Highway face ruin and danger along Lake Everstill's southern shore. Before the First War, this vital, heavily traveled road carried trade through Redridge; now gnolls and Blackrock orcs make passage perilous.

Before the First War, Lakeridge Highway carried goods and travelers through Redridge as a busy trade route along Lake Everstill's southern shore. In those peaceful days, travelers crossed between the valley settlements and the eastern heights under Stormwind's protection. The Horde's march shattered that safety, leaving eastern Redridge contested and desolate.

After Blackrock orcs seized Stonewatch Keep, regular road repairs and patrols stopped. Lakeridge Highway soon crumbled into an overgrown track, contested by savage gnoll packs. Stormwind's forces are spread thin and cannot reinforce Lakeshire, leaving the highway officially unsafe. Travelers bound for the eastern ridges must face gnoll ambushes along the way.
